title: Rest Up, Deary
description: You've sent some mail, but look at the poor pigeon, deary. It's all worn out from that hard work. Tell you what, how about you craft it a [pigeon hole](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/pigeonholes.png)? It's quite a suitable resting place for them, and if it's close enough to your mailbox, you shouldn't have to worry about the little fella wandering off.
